items.question: How will I receive my UAE visa?
items.answer: Once your visa is processed and approved by the immigration authorities, it will be sent directly to your registered email address as a secure PDF.

items.question: Can I get a refund if my visa application is rejected?
items.answer: Visa refusal does not automatically create a refund entitlement because TASHIRA provides application-processing services and does not decide approval. Refund eligibility depends on whether processing started and on actual third-party costs under our Refund/Cancellation Policy.

items.question: How many days will my visa processing take?
What are the different types of UAE visas available?
items.answer: We offer various options including tourist visas (14, 30, or 60 days), single or multiple entry, and transit visas. Your choice should be based on the purpose and duration of your visit.

items.question: What are the penalties for overstaying in the UAE?
items.answer: Overstaying is a serious legal violation. Fines start from AED 50 per day. Furthermore, overstaying can result in a lifetime ban from entering the UAE and other Gulf countries. We strongly advise renewing your visa or departing before its expiration.
